This weekend was nothing short of amazing ✨ From soaking in all the beauty Tennessee has to offer to diving into new adventures, my heart is full. 💛  

I spent the days making lasting memories with people who matter, laughing until my cheeks hurt, and finding hope in the most unexpected places. Sometimes it’s the little moments — the sunset drives, the conversations, the smiles — that remind you that life is meant to be lived fully. 🌄🌿  

I feel so blessed to be on this journey of rediscovering myself, chasing happiness again, and realizing just how much joy there is in simply being present. Tennessee, you’ve been so good to me — and I’m grateful for every memory being made here. 🤍  

Here’s to more adventures, more laughter, and continuing to find myself along the way.  

---

---

Lately, I’ve been feeling something I haven’t in a long time… like I’m finally home. 🏡✨  

I’m remembering what it feels like to truly be *me* again — to breathe a little deeper, to laugh without forcing it, to find peace in the quiet and joy in the simple things. For so many years, I let the chaos of life pull pieces away from my soul. But now, I’m rediscovering the moments that give me peace and bring my heart back to life. 🌿💫  

It’s the stillness, the little adventures, the slower days, and the people who remind me of what really matters. This journey back to myself hasn’t been easy, but it’s been so worth it. And for the first time in a long time, I feel at peace with where I’m at — and excited for what’s ahead. 🤍  

---
